condition: For data with extreme magnitudes (around 1e±180 or beyond), the intermediate variance underflows to 0 or overflows to inf, so ttest_1samp/ttest_rel return t=inf with p=0 or t=0 with p=1, even though the correct t-statistic is within range.
workaround: Rescale the data to a moderate magnitude before running the test, for example by dividing by a power of two near max(abs(x)). The t-statistic does not depend on scale.
